title: Shoot Through a Different World with Magical Eyes and Bullets!
titleRomaji: Magan to Dangan wo Tsukatte Isekai wo Buchinuku!
titleEnglish: Shoot Through a Different World with Magical Eyes and Bullets!
titleNative: 魔眼と弾丸を使って異世界をぶち抜く！
synonyms: Break Through in Another World With Magical Eyes and Bullets!!
synopsis: Stuck in a world that is not his own, the God of this world gives Ataru three special powers - magic eyes that see through everything, a gun only he can wield, and the power to make magic bullets at will. With rescued slave companion Caro at his side, what kind of adventures can they find together? (Source: Manga Planet)

title: Game Sekai de Mamono ni Tensei shiteshimatta Ore, Zense de Oshi datta Heroine wo Hirotteshimau
titleRomaji: Game Sekai de Mamono ni Tensei shiteshimatta Ore, Zense de Oshi datta Heroine wo Hirotteshimau
titleNative: ゲーム世界で魔物に転生してしまった俺、前世で推しだったヒロインを拾ってしまう
synonyms: I Reincarnated as a Monster in a Game World, and Picked Up the Heroine Who Was My Oshi in My Previous Life
synopsis: When I woke up, I had reincarnated into the world of a game I played in my past life. And what's more, as a monster that's hostile to humanity! It couldn't be helped, so I just lived quietly so humans wouldn't find me, but... The heroine, Noa, who was my oshi in my past life, had collapsed near my home!! After I protected and nursed her, my oshi gave me the name "Rei", so I decided to follow and protect Noa as my oshi for life. I meet other characters from the game too, and I'm watching over Noa's growth, but... the real Noa seems to be the type who's a bit clingy and has a... "heavy" love? This is the story of me, reincarnated as a monster, somehow overcoming hardships together with my beloved oshi. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Yuru Yuri
synopsis: Right after starting middle school, Akari Akaza joins the Amusement Club which is composed solely by her two childhood friends, Kyouko Toshinou and Yui Funami. Chinatsu Yoshikawa, Akaza's classmate, becomes a member after finding out about the dissolution of the Tea Club. The Amusement Club, situated at the tea room facility since the Tea Club disbanded, has no clear purpose, being free for the girls to do whatever they want. (Source: Anime News Network)

title: Arpeggio of Blue Steel
synonyms: สงครามเรือรบสยบโลก
synopsis: In the early 21st century, the majority of Earth’s landmass is submerged due to rising sea levels. Enter the Fleet of Fog, a host of sentient alien battleships of unknown origin who easily decimate earth’s naval forces. Humanity is now on the verge of extinction. In the year 2056, the stalwart Captain Chihaya Gunzou and his intrepid crew on the Blue Steel fleet may be humanity’s last chance to fight off the alien invaders. The Blue Steel fleet happens to contain a secret weapon that could turn the tide of war: a mysterious I-401 submarine that can transform into a girl. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Notes: Nominated to the 22nd Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize.

title: Colori Colore Creare
titleNative: コローリ コローレ クレアーレ
synopsis: The quiet island town of Onobori is hidden from the world by a Noren — a traditional curtain that veils it from the ordinary. Here lives Aka, a gentle, innocent girl living in a windmill coffee shop with her grandfather. Life flows peacefully, until a chance encounter with a giant black cat draws her into a subtle, spellbinding journey. As moments of quiet beauty unfold around her, Aka begins to stitch together the vibrant threads of a future shaped by kindness, connection, and wonder. (Source: Titan Manga)
